concepts.summary: Gun Wash, which is Wanda Push with a Bubble attached. Offset gun mid zone to the open side with the bubble as a built in answer. The line accounts for four down and two backers in the box and alerts a Push call to a free safety.
concepts.qb: Toes at five yards. Kick back and shuffle to clear the back's path, then carry out the keeper fake. The game plan may turn this into a pass set.
concepts.hb: Inside leg on the guard's outside leg. Open with a lateral step and aim for the B gap.
concepts.criteria: Can vs play side pressure or a four count.

positions.OL: Box count with the Push call to the free safety. Combinations shown: B/Money, Single, Money. One diagram marks the backside tackle Sift.

concepts.can: Vs play side pressure or a four count.
